name: Resource Lease / Lock
purpose: A filesystem lease/lock so several processes on this one machine arbitrate contended resources: acquire/release/renew/status/list a named lease with a TTL. Atomic (CreateNew = open O_CREAT|O_EXCL), race-safe stale reclaim, holder identity + a lease_id token, blocking or non-blocking acquire. Conventional resources: gpu (one model run at a time), git (commit lock), doc:<path> (doc-ownership). The multi-instance coordination primitive.

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: acquire | release | renew | status | list (one per invocation).

inputs.name: resource
inputs.description: The resource name (required for all but list). Conventional: gpu, git, doc:<path>; any string works.

inputs.name: holder
inputs.description: Stable identity of the caller. Default: $env:LIFEORCH_INSTANCE, else <host>:<pid>:<guid8>. Set a stable holder per instance so re-attach + release-by-holder work.

inputs.name: ttl_seconds
inputs.description: acquire/renew: the lease lifetime; an expired lease is reclaimable. Renew before it expires.

inputs.name: wait_seconds
inputs.description: acquire: block/poll up to this long for the resource to free. 0 = try once (non-blocking).

inputs.name: lease_id
inputs.description: release/renew: the token returned by acquire (proves you hold this exact lease).

inputs.name: note
inputs.description: Free text stored in the lease (e.g. what the holder is doing).

inputs.name: lease_dir
inputs.description: Override the shared lease directory (default $env:LIFEORCH_LEASE_DIR, else runtime/leases). All processes MUST resolve the same dir.

outputs.description: acquire: {acquired, lease_id, holder, expires_at_utc, ttl_seconds, waited_ms, reclaimed_stale, already_held, held_by}. release: {released, reason, held_by}. renew: {renewed, lease_id, expires_at_utc, renew_count, reason}. status: {exists, held, stale, holder, lease_id, expires_at_utc, seconds_remaining}. list: {count, leases:[...]}.
